name: @pipeworx/mcp-sentinel-hub

tools.name: sentinelhub_ndvi_stats
tools.description: NDVI vegetation statistics over an area and time range — returns per-interval mean/min/max/stdev of the vegetation index (NDVI) from Sentinel-2 imagery for a bbox or GeoJSON polygon. Derived numbers only, no imagery. Example: sentinelhub_ndvi_stats({ bbox: [12.44, 41.87, 12.53, 41.93], date_from: "2023-05-01", date_to: "2023-09-01", aggregation: "P1M", _apiKey: "client_id:client_secret" })

bbox.description: Bounding box [minLon, minLat, maxLon, maxLat] in EPSG:4326. Provide this OR `geometry`.

geometry.description: A GeoJSON Polygon geometry (EPSG:4326) as an alternative to `bbox`.

_apiKey.description: Sentinel Hub OAuth credentials as "client_id:client_secret" (from sentinel-hub.com or free at dataspace.copernicus.eu).

tools.name: sentinelhub_catalog_search
tools.description: Which satellite scenes are available for an area + time — searches the Sentinel-2 catalog (STAC) and returns matching scenes with acquisition datetime and cloud cover. Example: sentinelhub_catalog_search({ bbox: [12.44, 41.87, 12.53, 41.93], date_from: "2023-06-01", date_to: "2023-06-30", limit: 10, _apiKey: "client_id:client_secret" })

bbox.description: Bounding box [minLon, minLat, maxLon, maxLat] in EPSG:4326.

_apiKey.description: Sentinel Hub OAuth credentials as "client_id:client_secret" (from sentinel-hub.com or free at dataspace.copernicus.eu).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-sentinel-hub forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the sentinel-hub pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
